articles.title: Veterans ministry to expand state awards to independence activists
articles.description: The veterans ministry said Wednesday it will seek to identify more independence activists who have yet to be recognized for their role in achieving Korea's independence from Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule and award state honors to them.
